title: A moved function lost an import
defect: A module split left out imports; it compiled, but a route raised NameError at run time.
cause: The names the moved functions use were not imported or defined in the new module.
fix: For every new module, list its free names and confirm each one is imported or defined there.

title: A call hidden from the docs check
defect: A route called a helper through a module-name lookup or dict dispatch, so the docs check did not see the call.
cause: The docs check follows plain calls from route handlers only.
fix: Use plain, explicit calls, especially for anything that publishes an event or writes an audit row.

title: Tests appended to a file over 1,500 lines
defect: New tests were appended to a file that is already over 1,500 lines, so its size grew.
cause: The giant-files rule forbids growing a large file and was not checked before the edit.
fix: Put new tests in a new test file named for the behaviour.

title: SQL written in a route or service
defect: A route or service module contained a SQL statement.
cause: SQL belongs only in repository or data-access modules; the boundary check rejects it.
fix: Move the query into the aggregate's repository and call the repository from the service.

title: Broad except without a reason
defect: A new 'except Exception' had no written reason and hid a failure.
cause: The broad-except baseline counts every handler that catches Exception without a reason.
fix: Catch the narrowest type that can occur, or add a comment that states the reason.

title: New route missing from the docs Routes section
defect: A changed HTTP route was not named under a Routes heading of a changed docs/v4 page, so the docs check failed.
cause: The documentation check requires one bullet per changed route, read from the route code.
fix: Add one bullet per changed route, as '- `METHOD /path` one plain sentence', after reading the handler.

title: An oddity was fixed during a refactor
defect: A refactor changed a response or a log line that the ticket did not ask to change.
cause: Oddities were corrected in place instead of being pinned by a test and listed for a decision.
fix: Pin the current behaviour with a test that passes on unchanged code, then list each oddity under Needs a decision.

title: Function grew past the size or complexity budget
defect: A function passed 80 lines or McCabe complexity 12 after an edit.
cause: The quality baseline may only shrink, and the change added branches to an existing function.
fix: Split the new decision into a small helper with its own unit test before adding the branch.
